name: Homm Chura Samui
short_description: A 4-star, 65-room hotel in Bophut with a beachfront pool and sea views, part of Accor's Homm brand.
ai_summary: Homm Chura Samui is a 65-room hotel in the Bophut area of Ko Samui, positioned by its own Accor listing as offering a beachfront pool and sea views. No aggregate ALL guest rating was shown on the hotel's page at the time of research.

core_facts.address: 99/9 Moo 2 Chaweng Beach Road, Tumbon Bophut, Amphore Koh Samui, 84320 Surat Thani, Thailand
elite_benefits: Complimentary breakfast or lounge access for ALL Diamond members at participating hotels, per ALL - Accor Live Limitless program terms
Room upgrades for Platinum and Diamond members, subject to availability
Late check-out until 4pm for Diamond members, subject to availability

pros: 65 rooms with a beachfront pool and sea views in Bophut
Mid-scale Homm brand positioning offers good value relative to Ko Samui's luxury resorts
cons: No aggregate ALL guest rating was shown on the hotel's own page at the time of research
Smaller, newer property with less established track record than long-running Ko Samui resorts
research_highlights: Accor's own hotel page confirms 65 rooms and a beachfront pool with sea views
research_watchouts: The hotel's own Accor page did not display a customer review rating at the time of research -- none is included here rather than estimating one
Facts sourced from the hotel's own Accor listing page only; no independent dated review or video was found to cross-check against

faqs.question: How many rooms does Homm Chura Samui have?
faqs.answer: 65 rooms, located in the Bophut area of Ko Samui with a beachfront pool and sea views. Homm is Accor's mid-scale brand, so the property positions itself as a good-value alternative to Ko Samui's larger luxury resorts, though its own Accor listing did not display an aggregate guest rating at the time of research.

source_mix.label: Official Homm Chura Samui page on ALL - Accor Live Limitless
